scope.description: Generalization of the accept-phase repair gap from two nodes to three, where hiding the quorum from the leader requires dropping both follower receipts.
assumptions: 3-node cluster, majority quorum, error-free memory storage, in-order delivery of everything except the deliberately dropped receipts
the leader is identified by leader_priority; the cluster is given time to reach the accept phase before the proposal
writes are hand-driven; no real network and no concurrency
excluded: any rate or probability claim about how often both receipts are lost

basis.prefix: Deterministic in-process simulation of the core crate, hosted in the runtime crate's test target only because it needs nothing from the actor layer (no spawning, no runtime impl): three real OmniPaxos instances over MemoryStorage, driven by hand - one logical step ticks one node, drains its outgoing messages into a FIFO and delivers them, then does the same for the next node, so heartbeat replies land in the round that asked for them. Node 1 has leader_priority 1; election_tick_timeout 3, resend_message_tick_timeout 5, batch_size 1. Case `three_nodes_quorum_critical_loss_leaves_entry_undecided`: wait for node 1 to be leader in the accept phase with a majority accepting; append one entry at the leader (one proposal produces one AcceptDecide per promised follower, i.e. two); discard exactly the two followers' Accepted receipts; run 500 steps = 100 configured resend periods with no further proposal. It emits CA_EVENT three_node_lost_accepteds_window {steps,resend_periods,produced,dropped,after_drop,accept_decide_total,leader_decided_idx,follower_2_accepted_idx,follower_3_accepted_idx,both_followers_hold_undecided_entry} and asserts exactly two Accepted receipts were dropped, both followers really accepted the entry (accepted_idx 1) and hold it as Undecided at index 0, the leader is still at decided index 0 after the window, and only the two AcceptDecide messages of the single proposal crossed (no new proposal). It then appends a second entry and emits CA_EVENT three_node_later_proposal_repairs {steps_until_decided,leader_decided_idx}. The 2-node cases from the earlier harness (lost Accepted -> undecided; delivered -> decided; later proposal repairs) are included unchanged so the comparison spans both cluster sizes in one execution.
